constraints: Research only; do not enable app sources, import runtime catalogs or deploy.

Free reader login is acceptable when the catalog is queryable; label account requirements and do not create accounts automatically.
completion_definition: All known existing/current/historical analysis is captured with reproducible provenance; every identified linked/named lead has an evidence-backed canonical triage decision; every retained queryable source has eight complete dossier sections and ten current passing distinct examples; blocked/rejected cases retain concrete evidence, missing checks and useful revisit triggers; all 49 areas have explicit complete coverage reviews and all 18 USA/India civic cells are accounted. Each content category/industry reaches 100 qualified independent origins where supply supports it, or a real evidence-backed shortfall remains open until explicitly accepted by the owner. Partial claims, URL counts, overlaps, plans and schedules do not establish completion or exhaustion of internet sources.
analysis_capture_scope: all repository free-content research documents and JSON evidence
approved free-content design artifacts and referenced binary evidence
source-level historical/contextual findings with document and line provenance
current and failed query observations; access/policy evidence; explicit unknowns

coverage_target.closure: Evidence-backed area review and qualified-origin target; civic tracks additionally need both country cells accounted. Documented scarcity needs explicit owner acceptance with provenance; unresolved questions keep the area open.
coverage_target.counting: Memberships overlap. Do not add them into a unique-origin total or treat candidate/query examples as complete qualification.
